scope: Adapted StoneMaster close-punch and source-gem ranged encounter. Seven exact source actions retain all source records; Cast/Gem dispatch, independent flight, targeting and combat rules are explicit prototype adaptations, not restored original AI.

notes: Canonical source action attack stays attack, not attack1. Its13records/645ms remain unmodified;300–525ms punch hit window is adapted. Cast adds11source records with80ms×10+200ms=1000ms; physics selects held source frames without advancing the render actor clock twice.

Independent doll_gallery_state stores only transient encounter HP/cleared/counters. Shared route_hero_hp remains max100. No Profile, quest, first_drop, rewards, currency, inventory or ownership write is implemented here.

After a naturally completed punch, the enemy backsteps toward one ground-constrained50px target over0.35s at50/0.35 pixels/s while keeping its attack facing. Original Move frames are reused for this adapted retreat, not claimed as a source MoveBack action.
Physical bodies/walk bounds may shorten retreat. One enemy hit latch is consumed on each valid ordinary/guarded contact; retreat never resets that latch. The next accepted punch sets it false.

1.3s cooldown is set at attack start. Common pause/menu/modal/inspection/travel and own hurt/QA gates retain the base encounter clock policy. Damage interruption cancels the remaining retreat; recovery starts pursuit rather than resuming a stale target.

On reentry, HP/clear/base encounter counters persist but the enemy uses the authored safe spawn. Half-attacks, half-retreats, cast locks/cooldown and live gems are not resumed. R resets local HP/clear/AI/cast/projectiles while historical quest/loot/equipment/chapter receipts remain separate.

The direct source PunchATK STONE_DMG contact tag remains the close-punch sound only. Gem uses source StoneAttackGem JEWEL_HIT only on an applied unblocked projectile contact. No guessed cast/attack/hurt/death voice is assigned.

Hero attack rules copy the current accepted first_encounter_rules values, including Ghost Slash and the existing profile.weapon_damage_bonus()0/4; no source item attack72 or original monster formula is used.
Original10000ms damage/down records remain inspection holds; explicit0.4s hurt/0.6s death behavior reuses the accepted base encounter adaptation.

Ranged selection at90–210px and lane depth18 is adapted. The source Cast pose is the telegraph: locked facing/foot lane, no homing, one emission at1000ms from footX+facing×16px. A real hero hit interrupts an un-emitted cast; it does not remove previously fired gems. Close punch and its50px/0.35s retreat retain priority at close range.

Independent GemProjectiles uses the original13records/615ms cycle centered at native15×16crop size, while320px/s horizontal flight,615ms lifetime,visual height56px,physical damage10,depth18,contact half-width18.3px and jump-height35 dodge are adapted. Original equipment offsets are preserved in source data, not interpreted as an independent flight trajectory. No original MOB-to-equipment projectile dispatcher has been proved.

Cast and ranged cooldown pause with the inherited combat/own-hurt/QA AI gates; emitted gems have their own physics clock, freeze for pause/menu/modal/inspection/fade, and continue during caster hurt or qa_freeze_enemy. R, scene exit, caster defeat and player KO clear live gems. Projectile hits use swept incoming points for frontal guard (10 raw becomes6), the inherited hurt/KO behavior and shared HP persistence; Profile/rewards are untouched. A Gem contacting an already hurt-locked hero is consumed once as impact_immune with zero damage/audio; airborne/depth dodges may pass through.
